verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's own venture capital practice page presents it as an international VC adviser that is a key player in Europe and well known to leading investors in Asia and the US. Its office footprint spans Europe, Asia-Pacific and Africa. That supports the international-investor element of cross-border venture work, but the other named elements are not evidenced. Missing for 10: any documented flip or redomiciliation work, explicit multi-jurisdiction financing matters or case studies, and independent corroboration of cross-border VC deals.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings

citations.quote: a key player in the European venture capital community and well known to the leading investors in Asia and the US
Bird & Bird is a leading international legal adviser to high-growth companies within the venture capital ecosystem
